responsibility: Declares the growable `OutBuffer` utility used throughout the D front end for building text and binary fragments. The class exposes the mutable byte array, current offset, indentation controls, and the append/insert/format/extract methods needed by pretty-printers, manglers, token printers, and file emitters.
same_name_distinction: Defines the OutBuffer class layout, constructor/destructor, and method surface for buffered text/binary output; unlike outbuffer.c, it does not implement resizing, formatting, encoding, or extraction operations.
